status: analysis definition frozen before real-data experiments; not biological validation
replication_unit: simulation seed; no cell-level p-values and no claim of biological replication
time: committed snapshot hours; round decisions attach to the following snapshot; comparisons use exact common times
missing: undefined denominator, unavailable provider scores and nonspatial metrics remain null, never zero

aggregation.median_ci95: percentile bootstrap of the median, resampling seeds with replacement
aggregation.seed_envelope: empirical quantiles 0.025 and 0.975 with linear interpolation; not a confidence interval
aggregation.paired_contrast: arm minus baseline within matching seed and common time, followed by median and seed bootstrap
aggregation.failure_policy: any incomplete seed excludes the entire arm from aggregate results; all run records remain available

readouts.name: living_cells
readouts.definition: cells whose committed status is alive

readouts.name: activated_fraction
readouts.definition: living cells with activated true divided by living cells

readouts.name: exhausted_fraction
readouts.definition: living cells with exhausted true divided by living cells

readouts.name: cumulative_kills
readouts.definition: cumulative committed kill events from time zero; blocked proposals excluded

readouts.name: cumulative_apoptoses
readouts.definition: cumulative committed apoptosis events from time zero; blocked proposals excluded

readouts.name: cumulative_clearances
readouts.definition: cumulative committed clear_corpse events from time zero; blocked proposals excluded

readouts.name: cumulative_divisions
readouts.definition: cumulative committed division events from time zero; blocked proposals excluded

readouts.name: cumulative_killed_targets
readouts.definition: cumulative kill events attributed to the target lineage

readouts.name: malignant_activated_cd8_contact_fraction
readouts.definition: fraction with >=1 living activated CD8 within declared centroid radius and same sample; exhaustion does not exclude activated CD8; uses geometry, independent of capped action graph

readouts.name: mean_cd8_to_malignant_distance_um
readouts.denominator: living CD8 cells with >=1 living malignant target in the same sample
readouts.definition: mean nearest malignant centroid distance across eligible CD8 cells; nonspatial runs remain null

readouts.name: jev_prior_js_bits
readouts.denominator: provider-scored decisions in the just-completed round
readouts.definition: mean Jensen-Shannon divergence of Jev versus gated guidebook prior; local or single-action decisions do not contribute

readouts.name: occupied_bins
readouts.definition: bins with status alive and positive occupancy

readouts.name: total_occupancy
readouts.unit: abstract occupancy units; a full bin has the declared lattice.capacity
readouts.definition: sum of raw occupancy across occupied bins; not a count of cells and not normalized by capacity

readouts.name: cumulative_occupancy_gained
readouts.unit: abstract occupancy units; a full bin has the declared lattice.capacity
readouts.group: receiving lineage and ALL; lattice only
readouts.definition: sum of added_occupancy in committed occupancy_gain events

readouts.name: cumulative_occupancy_lost
readouts.unit: abstract occupancy units; a full bin has the declared lattice.capacity
readouts.group: affected lineage and ALL; lattice only
readouts.definition: sum of removed_occupancy in committed occupancy_loss events

interpretation: software readouts only; expression/LLM/spatial claims require the predeclared null controls and independent reference data
kernel_units: Cell-agent and lattice ensembles are separate. Lattice emits occupancy/bin readouts, never living_cells, cell event counts, cell state fractions or cell centroid-distance readouts.
